profile.headline: Software Engineer at Publix, Data and AI Services
profile.summary:
I get to work with brilliant and creative persons on building things that make people’s life a little bit easier. Sometimes it’s making new features for clients and users, others it’s improving systems, processes, and code to help fellow engineers develop and deploy with less effort. 

I’m a software engineer experienced in developing and deploying Javascript applications, particularly in React, Redux, and Node.js. I advocate for scalable microarchitecture patterns and modular front-ends. I’m also an active contributor to open source tools.

https://github.com/crperezt

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Nominated for the Productivity Booster award at React Open Source Awards 2020
• Expanded React SPA (Chrome DevTools extension) for time-travel state debugging of React applications, leveraging declarative components and Hooks for efficient rendering.
• Leveraged React Fiber internals to implement time-travel state debugging of useState and useContext hooks by programmatically injecting code into pages to read and write Fiber nodes, eliminating the previous need to install debugging libraries to retrieve states and dependencies.
• Implemented useReducer and useContext hooks to centralize the application state while maintaining scalability and render performance, applying the flux and reducer design patterns with reusable components to produce declarative views while avoiding excessive prop-drilling.
• Leveraged Typescript for its static-typing and error display at compilation time to help speed the development process, enhancing product maintainability, reusability and extensibility.
• Integrated Jest with Enzyme and Puppeteer to  enable test-driven development by leveraging shallow rendering and mocking to improve reliability and expedite integration of new features.
• Developed an internal library for performing event-triggered traversals of deeply-nested and circular Fiber structure to retrieve and transmit a hierarchy of class, function and host components, state setter functions, and render times to enable debugging and state changing.
• Utilized AcornJS to parse JS/JSX functional component code to retrieve variable and function names associated with stateful hooks, improving clarity for state debugging.
• Employed Agile / Scrum development process of code reviews and sprints to encourage teamwork, accountability, and rapid delivery of high-quality software.

positions.title: Fairpay - Anonymized salary-sharing tool
positions.description:
• Built Express.js server to handle API requests to multiple endpoints, applying a middleware design pattern to modularize request handling, enhancing code reusability and extensibility.
• Implemented Postgresql database schema to store relational employee data across multiple tables, enabling ACID compliance and detailed queries and aggregations, and leveraging pg-promise to create secure and sanitized queries including user input.
• Utilized Material-UI component library with React to rapidly deliver interactive and robust UI elements with a unified style implementing mobile-first design and fluid UX.

positions.title: KunligiConnect - Chat application for current times, built for NY-based non-profit Kunligi
positions.description:
• Developed a React / Redux SPA leveraging the action reducer design pattern to create a centralized state with predictable transitions for ease of debugging and maintainability.
• Leveraged Redux Thunk middleware to centralize the conditional dispatch of actions by  integrating asynchronous logic into the actions and re-using them across multiple components.

positions.title: Remix - Social media history aggregator
positions.description:
• Built Node.js server to handle incoming HTTP requests and responsively perform third-party API (Reddit) requests to retrieve listing data (upvoted posts) associated with users.
• Implemented a MongoDB / Mongoose NoSQL database schema for caching third-party API responses and relating them to user profiles, reducing response times and API requests.
• Implemented OAuth2 client authorization using refresh token grant type to obtain access to user data and simplify the authentication process through a trusted third-party API provider.

positions.title: Freelancer
positions.description:
● Designed and developed React / Redux SPA for legal practice management to manage case,
client, and task information, as well as tracking deadlines and scheduling in a unified dashboard.
● Created and deployed a Node / Express server to handle application requests and communicate with a Postgresql database, applying indexing for high performance data retrieval.
● Utilized Python and BeautifulSoup to automate client acquisition by periodically scraping legal freelance work websites, identifying relevant job postings, and automatically submitting detailed bids based on the scraped content, leading to a ten-fold increase in the number of leads.

positions.title: Patent Attorney
positions.description: • Drafted and procured patent applications for large Silicon Valley companies.

positions.title: Patent Attorney
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description: • Represented Fortune 500 companies in software patent infringement cases.
